name: The sea off Arpoador: extras (Rio pack, later)
notes: No new colours. Day uses the summer palette, the existing extra ramps (fam_aqua, water, pnd_deep, pnd_steel, mead_stone, fam_olive/leaf/pine, fam_blue, fam_violet, ch_rust, ch_sage, ch_navy, ch_teal, mead_heath, ch_hair8) and Ipanema's two sea ramps below (ipa_seabed, ipa_coral; listed in rio-pack/day1/ipanema/palette-extra.json, reused, not new). Night uses the approved night twins and night-only colours (sea_*, nl_*); rain uses Ipanema's rain twins.

reusedRamps.name: ipa_seabed
reusedRamps.use: sand seen through clear water (the sea floor off Arpoador); light to dark

reusedRamps.name: ipa_coral
reusedRamps.use: sea fans, coralline crust on the rocks and anemone bases (the sea off Arpoador); light to dark
